_comments_md.why_this_file_exists: Until 2026-08-24 this repository had NO verify.config.json at all, so 'file length' and 'section length' both reported N/A and every reduction was being made toward a number nothing measured. Written at sub-step 1.0 of phase 3a, with the class confirmed by Wouter.
_comments_md.max_lines: CLAUDE.md is size class L - 350 lines - because this project runs far past 8 sessions. It is a MAP rather than one number so that a later step can give another document its own declared cap without changing this one. A file matching no glob reports N/A, which is honest: a README and an evidence document have no size class.
_comments_md.section_caps: Section 7 is the handoff. It is replaced every session, so it is the section that bloats fastest, and 35 is the number in CLAUDE-TEMPLATE.md and in templates/verify.config.json. EVIDENCE-lt-charter-reduction.md says 60 in two places; the template wins where the two disagree, so 35 is what is enforced here.
_comments_md.forbidden_phrases_file: DELIBERATELY EMPTY. This project's scan lists live OUTSIDE the repository and are read by tools/leakage_scan.py and tools/publication_check.py, which are the controls that own confidentiality here. Declaring a path that is not found would report VOID, and wiring a second reader of those lists is section 5.4 work, not a checker setting.
_comments_md.size_scope: Only CLAUDE.md. Every OTHER markdown file at the root - the analysis documents, the EVIDENCE- documents, README.md - is evidence or plan content rather than a charter, so it has no size class; a file matching no glob reports N/A, which is honest. Deliberately stated WITHOUT a count: this comment said 'the six analysis documents' until 2026-08-24, when phase 3c added two EVIDENCE- files and made it wrong. And uk/ and us/ contain SKILL.md, never a CLAUDE.md, so nothing in a shipped tree is in scope.
